text:
Maria Chen: Heads-up — provisioning observability for the new eu-central-2 GPU cluster starts tomorrow. quick preflight: who's owning logs/metrics/traces and dashboards?
Kevin Patel: I can take metrics + alerts. will need prometheus scrape targets for the GPU nodes and the runtime exporter.
Jess Ortiz: I’ll own logs (loki) and traces (jaeger). need the index retention target and sampling for traces — budget constraints for EU region.
Samir Desai: I’ll do the handoff docs and the cost projections. reminder: this region has limited burst GPUs and higher egress cost.
Maria Chen: cool. couple of questions:
- what alert templates should we enable by default for new clusters?
- do we have a smoke dashboard for ML infra (GPU utilization, blocked pods, queue length)?
Kevin Patel: Alerts I'd enable by default:
- node_cpu_high (90% for >5m)
- gpu_memory_high (85% >5m)
- kube_pod_not_ready (>3m)
- pod_evicted_recently (>1m)
- container_restart_rate (5 restarts in last 10m)
Also a cost spike alert: cloud_egress_rate > $X/hr (Samir to define threshold).
Jess Ortiz: Loki retention: default 14d for eu clusters, with optional 90d archive to cold storage. Jaeger sampling: 0.02 global, 0.1 for inference routes (we need more for tail latency debugging).
Samir Desai: Cost: eu-central-2 egress is ~0.12 USD/GB. For the expected onboarding we estimate observability adds ~0.6k USD/mo with 14d retention, ~2.1k USD/mo if we keep 90d hot. I'll attach a quick calc in the handoff doc.
Maria Chen: can you paste the minimal scrape config we plan to deploy so I can add it to the bootstrap script?
Kevin Patel: sure — use this as the minimal prometheus scrape config for node and runtime exporters:
```yaml
scrape_configs:
  - job_name: 'kubernetes-nodes'
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: node
    relabel_configs:
      - action: labelmap
        regex: __meta_kubernetes_node_label_(.+)

  - job_name: 'gpu-runtime'
    kubernetes_sd_configs:
      - role: pod
    relabel_configs:
      - source_labels: [__meta_kubernetes_pod_label_app]
        regex: gpu-runtime
        action: keep
    metrics_path: /metrics
    scheme: http
```
Maria Chen: perfect. Jess — any Loki labels we should require to make search cheaper?
Jess Ortiz: require these labels on all app logs: cluster, namespace, app, gpu_type, node_pool. Add optional labels: run_id, model_name. Also enforce log level label and drop noisy debug logs from system components (kube-proxy etc.)
Samir Desai: for dashboards — we have a reusable "GPU cluster smoke" grafana dashboard id: 1204 (internal). It includes panels: GPU mem %, GPU util %, pod pending count, pending GPUs, kube-scheduler queue, cost burn rate. We should clone and set region variable = eu-central-2.
Maria Chen: what's our plan for trace sampling bump during a rollout? we don't want to blow costs.
Jess Ortiz: two-step plan:
1) Default 2% global sampling.
2) For canary rollout windows we increase inference routes sampling to 20% for 30m, then back down. We trigger via a simple API call to jaeger-collector-config or via k8s configmap. We'll document the command:
```bash
kubectl -n observability set env deploy/jaeger-collector SAMPLING_RATE=0.2
# wait 30m
kubectl -n observability set env deploy/jaeger-collector SAMPLING_RATE=0.02
```
Kevin Patel: add an alert for trace-traffic-surge: jaeger_ingest_bytes > 2x baseline for 5m -> alert ops.
Maria Chen: good. what about network constraints for eu-central-2? any special firewall rules for logs/metrics?
Samir Desai: yes — the region's default NAT gateways are rate-limited. we must route observability egress via our shared egress VPC endpoint to avoid throttles. Also S3 access must be to eu-central-2 bucket endpoints. Jess — configure loki to write to s3 eu-central-2 endpoint.
Jess Ortiz: noted. I'll update the helm values: { storage: s3, s3.endpoint: s3.eu-central-2.amazonaws.com, retention_days: 14 }
Maria Chen: who will run the smoke validation post-provision? checklist I propose:
- prometheus targets up for node & gpu-runtime
- loki write+query smoke (write 10 lines, query by label)
- jaeger span ingestion smoke (1 synthetic trace)
- import grafana dashboard clone -> verify panels render
- run alerts dry-run (alertmanager mute logs)
Kevin Patel: I'll run prometheus and alerts dry-run. my commands:
```bash
# check targets
curl -sS http://prometheus.svc.cluster.local:9090/api/v1/targets | jq .data.activeTargets | grep gpu-runtime
# simulate alert firing
kubectl -n monitoring exec -it deploy/promtool -- /bin/promtool test rules /etc/prometheus/rules/alerts.yaml
```
Jess Ortiz: I'll do loki + jaeger smoke. loki write example:
```bash
curl -s -XPOST "http://loki.monitoring.svc:3100/loki/api/v1/push" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"streams":[{"stream":{"cluster":"eu-central-2","app":"smoke"},"values":[["'$(date +%s%N)'","smoke test"]]}]}'
```
Samir Desai: I'll prepare the handoff doc template with expected thresholds and cost thresholds, link to runbook, and checklist. link: https://redwood-internal/ops/runbooks/eu-central-2-observability (placeholder)
infra-bot: deploy job queued: observability-bootstrap-euc2 (id: job-88412) :gear:
deploy-bot: deploy status: started (observability-bootstrap-euc2) — logs: https://ci.redwood/jobs/88412
Maria Chen: timeline: bootstrap tomorrow 09:00 UTC, smoke + handoff 11:00 UTC. Kevin/Jess/Samir please be on-call during window.
Kevin Patel: on it. I'll have alert thresholds ready.
Jess Ortiz: will bring loki + jaeger smoke scripts to the channel.
Samir Desai: prepping cost sheet and runbook now.
Maria Chen: thanks all. after handoff I'll add the final runbook to the infra repo and tag the cluster with metadata: region=eu-central-2, observability=enabled, retention=14d.
Kevin Patel: one last thing — add a Grafana alert to flag any dashboard panel with >50% no-data in last 10m (render failure). saves time when datasources misconfigured.
Maria Chen: agreed. that goes in the checklist. :thumbsup:
